action.mutates: holds /var/lib/dpkg/lock-frontend open (flock) for 15 s in a background shell, which writes the release time to /run/p8test-bootrun/released; starts puppet_boot_run.service, whose script makes one agent run against the lab master (the node's catalog, which the harness applied with a clean second run; the run writes the agent's state, reports and last run summary under /opt/puppetlabs/puppet/cache) and its log /tmp/puppet_boot_run.log; records the start time and copies the unit's log and result to /run/p8test-bootrun (start, run.log, run.rc)

action.mutates: holds /var/lib/dpkg/lock-frontend open (flock) for 150 s in a background shell, which then writes its release time to /run/p8test-bootrun/bounded-released; records the start time in /run/p8test-bootrun/bounded-start and starts puppet_boot_run.service (one agent run against the lab master, writing the agent's state under /opt/puppetlabs/puppet/cache and the script's log /tmp/puppet_boot_run.log), copied to /run/p8test-bootrun/bounded.log
